description: Implement RP2040 real-board motion support: dual-axis Pulse/Dir stepper + AB encoder, with PIO-first design, trapezoid profile, and a clean motion config + virtual feedback channel mapping for the DSL.

userStories.title: Define io_map motion config section (dual-axis, clean-first)
userStories.description: As a firmware developer, I want to declare stepper/encoder channels in io_map (axis0/axis1) so the motion mapping is explicit, reviewable, and not scattered across code.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a documented motion config section (e.g. `motion.stepper.axis0`, `motion.stepper.axis1`, `motion.encoder.axis0`, `motion.encoder.axis1`)
Per-axis required fields are specified: STEP/DIR/EN pins, encoder A/B pins, count sign convention, PPR/multiplier/scale parameters
Invalid configs fail with path-addressable errors (field path + reason)
Tests pass (`cargo test --workspace`)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement motion config parsing + semantic validation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want motion config parsing to catch conflicts and invalid ranges early so board debugging time is reduced.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement parsing/validation for motion config (pin conflicts, duplicate axis ids, invalid parameter ranges)
Add unit tests covering success and failure paths
Failure messages include config path and a concrete fix suggestion
Tests pass (`cargo test --workspace`)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate motion subsystem into board-rp2040 HAL lifecycle
userStories.description: As an architecture maintainer, I want the motion subsystem to plug into the existing board-rp2040 HAL shape so the main loop stays readable and trace/timing evidence remains stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Add motion hooks into the firmware lifecycle (`initialize`/`update_in`/`update_out`/`finalize_on_error`)
Motion code is organized into dedicated module(s), avoiding large logic blocks in main.rs

Typecheck passes

userStories.title: PIO step generator for axis0 (Pulse/Dir/EN) with trapezoid profile
userStories.description: As a machine/controls engineer, I want axis0 to generate stable Pulse/Dir/EN signals using PIO and support a trapezoid speed profile so basic motion is possible without complex planning.
acceptanceCriteria: Axis0 STEP/DIR/EN pins are bound from motion config and can be driven in firmware

Support trapezoid profile (accel/const/decel) with a minimal parameter set (documented defaults allowed)
